items.t: We're moving at the end of the month.
Do you know any good movers?
items.z: 你认识靠谱的搬家公司吗？

items.t: I'm selling my couch on Facebook Marketplace.
items.z: 我在 Facebook 二手市场上卖沙发。

items.t: Is this still available?
Can you do porch pickup?
I can pick it up tonight if that works.
items.z: 方便的话我今晚就能来取。

items.t: It's in good condition, just a few scratches.
Do you have boxes I could use?
Can you help me carry this down the stairs?
items.z: 能帮我把这个搬下楼吗？

items.t: Lift with your legs, not your back.
I need to set up utilities at the new place.
Did you forward your mail?
The lease starts on the first.
I'm donating a bunch of stuff to Goodwill.
items.z: 我要捐一堆东西给 Goodwill。

items.t: The landlord's doing a walkthrough on Friday.
We should get our deposit back in two weeks.
items.z: 我们应该两周内能拿回押金。

items.t: Where do you want this box?
I'll label the boxes by room.
items.z: 我会按房间给箱子贴标签。

items.t: Pizza's on me for everyone who helped.
items.z: 帮忙的人今天披萨我请。

items.t: Housewarming party next month!
